originating_goal: Preserve the distinction between positional permission and present-tense consequence-bound admissibility, including contribution without capture.
trigger: PA-001 hosted validation is COMPLETE and source implementation/validation claims are released.

targets.required_action: Merge PA-001 only through Site orchestration after it is admitted as nonconflicting; do not bypass active HIL/heartbeat work.
Preserve PA-001 as bounded publication semantics; do not treat Publisher projection as publication or execution authority.
Merge PA-001 into the canonical admissibility workstream without duplicating active validation or Riverbraid implementation.
Queue bounded Guardian interpretation only after admissibility-wiki evidence exists; preserve visibility != authority and documentation != enforcement.

required_outputs: target-native validation result or machine-observable blocker
publication_boundary: State only that permission and admissibility are distinct. Do not claim permission is universally unnecessary. Do not imply execution authority, deployment, legal authority, Guardian authority, or runtime activation from PA-001.
duplicate_prevention: Do not mutate a target when an active claimant already owns the same publication path; merge the missing PA-001 requirement into that target's canonical workstream instead.
release_condition: All four targets have either verified target-native propagation evidence or a durable blocker with named owner and machine-observable release condition.
